controls: Left/Right: change lane. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
title: Pocket Racer
learn: A scrolling road, lane decisions and rectangle collision.
goal: Pass 20 rival cars before your three shields are gone.

controls: Left/Right: walk. Z (A): jump. Enter (Start) or Z: start/restart.
title: Moon Courier
learn: Signed vertical velocity, gravity, ground checks, parcels and delivery state.
goal: Pick up a parcel and reach the moon base on each of three routes.

controls: Arrows: move/push. X (B): reset this puzzle. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
title: Matcha Garden
learn: Grid movement, checking the next two cells, and a mutable tile board.
goal: Push the tea crate onto the flower in three compact garden puzzles.

controls: Arrows: explore. Enter (Start) or Z (A): start/restart.
title: Signal Lost
learn: A connected maze, collectible state, timed objectives and input repeat.
goal: Collect all three beacons, then find the exit before the 90-second battery runs out.

controls: Left/Right: move. Hold Z (A): fire. Enter (Start) or Z: start/restart.
title: Orbit Guard
learn: Independent player, projectile and enemy motion with AABB hits and enemy waves.
goal: Defeat 15 approaching drones before three reach your orbit.

controls: Enter: Start/restart; Left/Right: steer; Z (A): boost; X (B): brake; Shift (Select): title.
title: Drift Circuit
learn: A changing road centre, collision rectangles, a fixed frame clock and a three-speed car create a time trial.
goal: Finish a 3600-metre time trial within 40 seconds. Dodge traffic and stay inside the road; three hits end the round.

controls: Enter: Start/restart; Up/Down: fly; Z (A): speed up; Shift (Select): title.
title: Cloud Pilot
learn: Recycled obstacle slots, scrolling scenery and gap collision checks make a compact flying course.
goal: Fly through 24 moving gates before the 55-second timer expires. Three wall collisions end the round.

controls: Enter: Start/restart; Left/Right: paddle; Z (A): launch; Shift (Select): title.
title: Prism Break
learn: Ball velocity reflects from walls and the paddle; a 24-cell array tracks remaining bricks.
goal: Break all 24 coloured bricks in 100 seconds. Aim the ball with the paddle edge. You have three balls.

controls: Enter: Start/restart; Arrows: move one tile; Z (A): attack within 2 tiles; X (B): select enemy; Shift (Select): title.
title: Tiny Tactics
learn: A small turn-based state machine combines board occupancy, attack range, enemy movement and health.
goal: Defeat three sentries with nine health points and at most 40 turns. Every successful move or attack lets surviving enemies act.

controls: Enter: Start/restart; Arrows: move; Z (A): pick up/drop parcel; X (B): slow walk; Shift (Select): title.
title: Parcel Dash
learn: Pickup and delivery states, waypoint arrays and moving hazard rectangles form a delivery score attack.
goal: Pick up at POST and deliver to the gold address. Complete five deliveries in 60 seconds while avoiding three traffic hazards.
